items.tag: 叙事驱动的探索解谜游戏
items.title: 海默2000 2025.11.29
items.excerpt: 在这个游戏中，玩家作为一个回收人员，需要在这台电脑中去回收海默2000的最后一个核心部件，即它的情感部件。整体玩法让我想起了Her Story。
items.body:
1. 核心动词 & 核心循环

在这个游戏中，玩家作为一个回收人员，需要在这台电脑中去回收海默2000的最后一个核心部件，即它的情感部件。整体玩法让我想起了Her Story。

核心循环是玩家在地图中探索，了解部分关于这个世界的故事，然后在海默2000的记忆中搜索关键词寻找相关记忆，通过解锁记忆来解锁更多的地图，获得更多信息和关键词。除此之外还可以和海默2000（AI）进行对话，来开启大门，了解世界背景，解答疑惑等。

探索地图→了解故事→搜索记忆→解锁地图→探索地图

解锁大部分的记忆（了解故事后）可以到剧情开头的那栋楼来回收核心部件，进入结局。

2. 情绪

游戏整体的剧情是很压抑的，一开始是在一个破败的火车站，暗沉的色调，没有生机的环境，让玩家感到压抑与紧张。随着剧情推进，玩家会逐渐根据故事代入NPC们的经历，而感到无助与痛苦，感觉失去希望，因为他们都是复制人所以并不是特别的，他们的存在就是为了他人提供器官，和螃蟹没有区别。越是打到后面越是与NPC们共情与心痛。

3. 故事和系统

游戏的故事是很压抑的，因此用比较早期且被大家认为没有感情的AI作为引导NPC和主要交互对象是十分合适的。玩家在整个过程中没有一个合适的情感交流对象，只能和没有感情表露的AI进行交流。同时因为故事背景是为了避免复制人们逃离和确保他们的健康，他们被监控着，他们也被提供了海默2000来解决生活上的各种需求。因此这个游戏主要是靠玩家看和海默2000与NPC们的对话来了解故事背景和推进游戏发展的。

4. 体验节奏

从体验节奏来看，一开始有一些简单的引导，告诉我怎么判断可以和哪些东西交互，如何和海默2000对话，随着剧情的推进解锁更多的功能和玩法（虽然大多数玩法对剧情推进并没有什么用）在解锁每一个功能时会有新的教程。剧情推进后我要做的事情其实没有很大的变化，还是根据一开始的循环。

5. 反馈

这个游戏的主要反馈就是在你输入正确的关键词后，可以看到针对于这个关键词的真相，会有一种玩家正在破案的感觉。做对了会解锁新的信息和新的区域，这个游戏的也反馈不是外在奖励，而是‘我可以看到更深层的信息’这种内在动机；这种动机的成瘾性比奖励数值更强。

WWW：这个游戏的玩法很新奇也很有吸引力，自己找到的信息可以给玩家带来更大的成就感。除此之外在游戏中引入AI也很新颖。跟Her Story相比，这个故事玩家有更多的参与感，解锁地图和探索地图的玩法让玩家可以更容易进入心流状态，也更愿意花更多时间在这个游戏上。UI和沉浸感都做的很好，剧情写的很流畅也很引人入胜（很伤心TT）。

EBI：后期玩法重复性较高。

Alaaa 2025.11.29
items.excerpt_en: In this game you play a recycling worker who has to retrieve the last core component of Haimo 2000 inside this computer: its emotion module. The overall gameplay reminded me of Her Story.
items.body_en:
1. Core Verbs & Core Loop

In this game you play a recycling worker who has to retrieve the last core component of Haimo 2000 inside this computer: its emotion module. The overall gameplay reminded me of Her Story.

The core loop is that the player explores the map and learns parts of the world's story, then searches Haimo 2000's memory for keywords to find related memories. Unlocking memories unlocks more of the map, which yields more information and more keywords. You can also talk with Haimo 2000 (the AI) to open doors, learn the world's background, get your questions answered, and so on.

Explore the map → learn the story → search memories → unlock the map → explore the map

After unlocking most of the memories (once you understand the story), you can return to the building from the start of the plot to recycle the core component and reach the ending.

2. Emotion

The game's overall story is very oppressive. It begins at a run-down train station with dark tones and a lifeless environment, which leaves the player feeling suppressed and tense. As the story unfolds, the player gradually identifies with the NPCs' experiences and feels helpless and pained, as if all hope is lost: they're all clones, so they're nothing special, and they exist only to supply organs for others, no different from crabs. The further I played, the more I empathized with the NPCs and the more it hurt.

3. Story and Systems

The story is oppressive, so using a relatively early AI, widely considered to have no emotions, as the guide NPC and main point of interaction fits very well. Throughout the whole game the player has no suitable partner for emotional exchange and can only talk with an AI that shows no feelings. The story's background is that the clones are monitored to keep them from escaping and to make sure they stay healthy, and they were given Haimo 2000 to take care of their various daily needs. So the game relies mainly on the player's looking around and on conversations between Haimo 2000 and the NPCs to convey the background and move the game forward.

4. Pacing of the Experience

In terms of pacing, at the beginning there is some simple guidance that tells me how to judge which things I can interact with and how to talk to Haimo 2000. As the story advances, more features and mechanics unlock (though most of them don't do much for advancing the plot), with a new tutorial each time one unlocks. After the story moves along, what I actually have to do doesn't change much; it's still the loop from the beginning.

5. Feedback

The game's main feedback is that after you enter the right keyword, you get to see the truth behind that keyword, which gives the feeling that you're solving a case. Getting it right unlocks new information and new areas. The feedback isn't an external reward but an intrinsic motivation: "I can see deeper information." That kind of motivation is more addictive than reward numbers.

WWW: The gameplay is novel and very appealing, and information you find yourself gives you a bigger sense of accomplishment. Bringing an AI into the game is also fresh. Compared with Her Story, the player has more sense of participation in this story, and the map unlocking and exploring makes it easier to enter a flow state and more willing to spend more time on the game. The UI and immersion are both very well done, and the story is written smoothly and is really gripping (so sad TT).

EBI: The gameplay becomes fairly repetitive in the later part.

Alaaa 2025.11.29

items.title: Orwell 2025.11.30
items.excerpt: 在这款游戏中，玩家主要在收集信息，根据决定需要上传什么信息来发展不同的剧情走向。这也是和全网公敌不同的一点，全网公敌无法影响角色的路线走向，只能主要作为观察者的角色观察事件。
items.body:
1. 从“我在干嘛”开始：核心动词 & 核心循环

在这款游戏中，玩家主要在收集信息，根据决定需要上传什么信息来发展不同的剧情走向。这也是和全网公敌不同的一点，全网公敌无法影响角色的路线走向，只能主要作为观察者的角色观察事件。

简单来说就是： 观察→判断→上传→产生影响

循环起来会让玩家有我的决定可以影响剧情发展的感觉。

在游戏刚刚开始的时候，玩家是不知道自己具体的身份的，需要在玩的过程中逐渐发现自己在做什么，在为谁工作，并自己判断哪一边才是玩家认为“正义”的一方。

游戏分为五个关卡，循序渐进的让玩家逐渐了解案件背后的真相。玩家一开始从一位政治观点比较尖锐的女性开始了解游戏玩法，到后面解锁越来越多的玩法，可以开始偷听和黑入他人的电子设备，在解决一个大问题后会允许玩家休息一会儿（一天结束）。

2. 看“游戏在喂我什么情绪”

这个游戏让玩家一开始感受到掌控感，我们作为被邀请的专家可以使用最新的设备来收集他人信息，观察他人的生活。整体是因为获得权力而感到新奇的情绪。后面逐渐意识到他们的生活是被监视的，这种注视是无孔不入的，而因此感到些许窒息与压抑，同时也因为爆炸案在不停的发生，破案的压力带来了紧迫感与压力。玩家是被这种游戏中紧迫的氛围而被推动着去破解案件的。

掌控感→压迫感→紧迫感

3. 把“故事”和“系统”连起来看

故事和系统联系的十分紧密，这款游戏本身是叙事与游戏玩法绑定的十分紧密的，因此我很难想象如果说这个游戏换个玩法需要怎么玩。剧情推进时我经常会在游戏中得到窃听NPC的电话的机会，这也给玩家带来很深的参与感与代入感。

- 在这款游戏里，“偷听”和“截取信息”不是 mechanic，它们是叙事语言。
- 别的游戏在用对话框讲故事，而这个游戏在用监视行为本身讲故事。

4. 从“体验节奏”来拆：前10分钟 & 一整个 Session

从体验节奏来看，一开始创建新存档是模仿注册网站的页面，从这里开始给玩家心理铺垫。随后会有一名NPC出现引导玩家了解需要做的事情，以及一个具体的案例教我们怎么进行交互。我认为这种从实践中学习的方式非常有利于玩家熟悉游戏。

游戏全程基本是处在心流状态下走完的，游戏通过不断的让玩家拥有新的能力，来让玩家对于游戏的剧情推进拥有掌控感，从而保持心流状态。除了收集全成就需要反复重新打同样的内容有些烦躁以外都很完美。

5. 盯着“反馈”看：游戏怎么回应你？

如果说我成功的阻止了一场爆炸，我的NPC同事会称呼我为英雄；在发现一个恐怖的真相时，背景音乐会变得紧张急促。在成功收集到正确的信息时，玩家会被允许去收集和看到更多的信息，满足玩家的好奇心与成就感。这个游戏是以好奇心驱动而非奖励机制驱动来推进游戏的。游戏的反馈不是外在奖励，而是‘我可以看到更深层的信息’这种内在动机；这种动机的成瘾性比奖励数值更强。

WWW：这款游戏最强的地方在于玩家是可以介入游戏走向的，可以根据自己的判断来影响NPC的命运。同时这个游戏的玩法也非常的新鲜与新奇，和普通的视觉小说不一样，我觉得做到了展现interactive art的魅力。UI很漂亮，很有自己独特的风格。剧情讲述比较深入，作为奥威尔的书迷玩的很开心。随时会有一个NPC在对玩家的每个行为进行反馈，例如上传一个无关线索NPC会进行吐槽，上传一些特定信息NPC会有特殊对话，例如杀死一只知更鸟。

EBI：这款游戏的信息收集我觉得没有全网公敌那么完美，收集信息的自由度也没有全网公敌那么高。我觉得全网公敌是基于orwell的基础上做了一些改进。拖信息到框里后需要加载一段时间让玩家的游玩体验有些不流畅，以及有一些剧情不允许加速和跳过会让想要刷全成就的玩家感到有些痛苦。

如果我来做的话，我感觉我会提升整体游玩体验的流畅度，且在玩家第二次看剧情的时候允许加速。其他的部分我感觉都非常完美，非常好的游戏！

Alaaa 2025.11.30
items.excerpt_en: In this game the player mainly collects information and, based on decisions, chooses what to upload to send the story in different directions. This is also what sets it apart from Cyber Manhunt (全网公敌), where you can't affect the characters' paths and are mainly an observer of events.
items.body_en:
1. Starting from "What Am I Doing?": Core Verbs & Core Loop

In this game the player mainly collects information and, based on decisions, chooses what to upload to send the story in different directions. This is also what sets it apart from Cyber Manhunt (全网公敌): in that game you can't affect the characters' paths and are mainly an observer of events.

Simply put: observe → judge → upload → cause an impact.

Looping through this gives the player the feeling that their decisions can influence how the story develops.

At the start of the game the player doesn't know their specific identity. You gradually discover what you're doing and who you're working for as you play, and you decide for yourself which side you consider the "just" one.

The game has five chapters that gradually lead the player to the truth behind the case. The player starts by learning the mechanics through a woman with rather sharp political views, and later unlocks more and more mechanics, such as eavesdropping and hacking into other people's electronic devices. After solving a big problem, the game lets the player take a break (the day ends).

2. Looking at "What Emotions Is the Game Feeding Me?"

At first the game gives the player a sense of control: as invited experts, we get to use the latest equipment to collect other people's information and observe their lives. Overall it's the novelty of gaining power. Later we gradually realize their lives are under surveillance, that this gaze is all-pervasive, and that makes us feel a bit suffocated and oppressed. Meanwhile, bombings keep happening, and the pressure to solve the case brings urgency and stress. The player is pushed forward to crack the case by this urgent atmosphere.

Sense of control → oppression → urgency

3. Connecting "Story" and "Systems"

The story and the systems are very closely linked. The game binds narrative and gameplay so tightly that I can hardly imagine how you'd play it if the mechanics were different. As the plot advances I often get the chance to wiretap NPCs' phone calls, which also brings deep participation and immersion.

- In this game, "eavesdropping" and "intercepting information" aren't mechanics; they're narrative language.
- Other games tell stories with dialogue boxes, while this game tells its story through the act of surveillance itself.

4. Breaking Down the "Pacing": the First 10 Minutes & a Whole Session

In terms of pacing, creating a new save imitates a website registration page, which starts building the player's mindset from there. Then an NPC appears to guide the player on what needs to be done, along with a concrete case that teaches us how to interact. I think this learn-by-doing approach is very helpful for getting players familiar with the game.

The whole game is basically played in a flow state. By constantly giving the player new abilities, the game gives them a sense of control over the story's progress and thereby keeps them in flow. Apart from the slight annoyance of having to replay the same content over and over to collect all achievements, it's perfect.

5. Staring at "Feedback": How Does the Game Respond to You?

If I successfully stop a bombing, my NPC colleague calls me a hero; when I discover a horrifying truth, the background music becomes tense and rapid. When I successfully collect the right information, I'm allowed to collect and see even more, which satisfies my curiosity and sense of accomplishment. The game is driven by curiosity rather than a reward system. The feedback isn't an external reward but an intrinsic motivation: "I can see deeper information." That kind of motivation is more addictive than reward numbers.

WWW: The game's greatest strength is that the player can intervene in where it goes and can influence the NPCs' fates through their own judgment. Its gameplay is also very fresh and novel, unlike an ordinary visual novel, and I feel it captures the charm of interactive art. The UI is beautiful and has a distinctive style of its own. The story goes fairly deep, and as a fan of Orwell's books I had a great time. An NPC is always around to react to each of the player's actions: for example, uploading an irrelevant clue gets a snarky comment, and uploading certain information triggers special dialogue, such as killing a robin.

EBI: I feel the information gathering here isn't as perfect as in Cyber Manhunt, and the freedom in gathering information isn't as high either. I think Cyber Manhunt made some improvements on top of Orwell. Dragging information into the box requires a loading time, which makes the play experience feel a bit choppy, and some story scenes can't be sped up or skipped, which is painful for players going for all achievements.

If I were making it, I feel I'd improve the smoothness of the overall play experience and allow speeding up the story the second time a player sees it. Everything else feels perfect to me. A wonderful game!

Alaaa 2025.11.30

items.title: Final Fantasy
items.excerpt: 因为这段时间沉迷ff14，所以为了更加了解ff的世界观而开始尝试打ff的早期作品。第一个尝试的就是最为经典的ff1，选择了游玩steam上的像素重制版。
items.body:
因为这段时间沉迷ff14，所以为了更加了解ff的世界观而开始尝试打ff的早期作品。第一个尝试的就是最为经典的ff1，但是因为考虑到找不到原版资源+像素重制版可以带来更好的游玩体验，而选择了游玩steam上的像素重制版。因为游玩目的是补充世界观知识，所以游玩过程主要依赖bilibili上的攻略，因此可能会丢失一些本身的游戏乐趣，但是整体来说感觉还是很新奇且引人入胜的。

游戏是标准且开创性的JRPG，世界被黑暗所笼罩，时间停止了，海干涸了，大地也在腐坏，不过人们一直坚信着某个预言，并一直在等待其成为现实。

“当世界被黑暗侵染之时，四位光之战士将会现身于世。”

玩家允许选择四位光之战士来拯救世界。可选的职业有6个，我个人选择了初始的战士，盗贼，黑魔法师，和白魔法师。其余的还有赤魔法师和武僧，可以选择黑魔和白魔的技能。战斗系统可以看出在和未来的八方旅人十分相像。

一开始是以拯救被绑架的公主来进行引入

光之战士需要通过人们的传言在地图上找到接下来要去的位置和完成的任务，并拯救世界。

我可以从ff1的故事里看出ff14里有很多ff1的世界观的延伸，例如住在山洞里的玛托雅，曾经和人们住在一起但如今却分开的龙族，用啦哩吼打招呼的矮人，龙神巴哈姆特，还有萨菲罗斯的正宗。还有熟悉的洞穴背景音乐，胜利音乐，水晶序曲等等。
items.excerpt_en: I've been hooked on FFXIV lately, so to understand the world of FF better I started playing the early games. The first one I tried was the classic FF1, using the pixel remaster on Steam.
items.body_en:
I've been hooked on FFXIV lately, so to understand the world of FF better I started playing the early games. The first one I tried was the classic FF1. Since I couldn't find the original version and the pixel remaster offers a better play experience, I chose the pixel remaster on Steam. Because my goal was to fill in world-building knowledge, I mainly followed walkthroughs on bilibili, so I may have lost some of the game's own fun, but overall it still felt fresh and gripping.

It's a standard and pioneering JRPG. The world is shrouded in darkness, time has stopped, the seas have dried up, and the land is rotting, yet people have always believed in a certain prophecy and kept waiting for it to come true.

"When darkness covers the world, four Warriors of Light will appear."

The player gets to pick the four Warriors of Light who will save the world. There are 6 classes to choose from, and I personally picked the starting Warrior, Thief, Black Mage, and White Mage. There are also the Red Mage and the Monk, and the Red Mage can use both black and white magic. The battle system is clearly very similar to the later Octopath Traveler.

It begins by rescuing a kidnapped princess as an introduction.

The Warriors of Light have to use rumors from people to find where to go next on the map and which tasks to complete, and save the world.

From FF1's story I can see that FFXIV has many extensions of FF1's world: for example Matoya living in a cave, the dragons who once lived with people but are now apart, the dwarves who greet you with "Lali-ho", the dragon god Bahamut, and even the origin of Sephiroth. There's also the familiar cave BGM, victory fanfare, the Crystal Prelude, and so on.

items.title: Final Fantasy II
items.excerpt: 从这一作开始角色有了名字，且将等级变成了熟练度制。这一作中也有反抗帝国军的剧情，以及陨石砸落类似于古代人世界末日的场景。
items.body:
进步：

从这一作开始角色有了名字，且将等级变成了熟练度制

!image.png

这一作中也有反抗帝国军的剧情，以及陨石砸落类似于古代人世界末日的场景

这一作有关键词标亮以及可以询问关键词，比上一作自己随缘找好很多

新加了蛙变，遗忘和诅咒

气球怪感觉像是爆弹怪的前身，在ff2有出现

旅馆收费改为根据受伤严重程度收费而非剧情进度

大河狸出现了

从ff2就开始队友祭天法力无边了

敏武qwq

坐骑音乐和陆行鸟

太阳之炎炸大战舰和炸魔洸炉有点像

龙骑与龙

魔界花

万魔殿

源氏

感受：

菲因有点像莉瑟的国家

野玫瑰：菲因国的纹章，蕴含祈祷强韧美丽的繁荣之深意

总结:

2游戏本身其实和光之战士没有什么关系，主要是四个菲因国的年轻人要拯救自己国家的故事。
items.excerpt_en: From this entry on, characters have names, and levels became a proficiency system. This one also has a plot about resisting the Imperial army, and a scene of meteors striking that resembles the Ancients' apocalypse.
items.body_en:
Improvements:

From this entry on, characters have names, and levels became a proficiency system

!image.png

This one also has a plot about resisting the Imperial army, and a scene of meteors striking that resembles the Ancients' apocalypse

This one has highlighted keywords and lets you ask about keywords, which is much better than finding things by luck like the last one

Added Toad, Amnesia, and Curse

The balloon monster feels like the predecessor of the Bomb, and it appears in FF2

Inn prices are now based on how badly hurt you are rather than story progress

The giant beaver appears

Since FF2, sacrificing party members to the gods has been all-powerful

Dexterity, martial arts qwq

The mount music and chocobos

Blowing up the great warship with the Sunfire is a bit like blowing up the Mako reactor

Dragoons and dragons

Malboro

Pandaemonium

Genji

Impressions:

Fynn feels a bit like Lise's country

Wild Rose: the emblem of the Kingdom of Fynn, carrying the deep meaning of prayer, resilience, beauty, and prosperity

Summary:

FF2 itself actually has nothing to do with the Warriors of Light; it's mainly the story of four young people from Fynn saving their own country.

items.title: Final Fantasy III
items.excerpt: 角色又失去了名字，且变得长得差不多，追求光与暗的平衡。ff3和ff1一样是四个光之战士（光明之魂）来拯救世界。
items.body:
update：

items.excerpt_en: The characters lose their names again and look nearly identical, and the game pursues a balance of light and dark. Like FF1, FF3 has four Warriors of Light saving the world.
items.body_en:
Update:

The characters lose their names again and look nearly identical

Pursuit of a balance between light and dark

Like FF1, FF3 has four Warriors of Light saving the world

But unlike FF1, where the legendary Warriors of Light appear to save the world, in FF3 four orphans fall into a cave as a test of courage and later become the messengers of light

The starting job is four Onion Knights

FF3 adds more dialogue between characters

Treasure chests have lower saturation

The battle music has changed

It's the Eternal Wind BGM!!!

You can play the piano and watch a dancer dance

Buying in bulk gets a discount

!image.png

A flower girl similar to Aerith appears for the first time

The Ruby Beast appears

Cid becomes a ghost

Magic switches back to a per-spell-uses system rather than a total-MP system

You can talk to the follower characters, and the party can have five members instead of having to sacrifice one

You can be attacked from behind now

The Ancients' lore appears for the first time

!image.png

!image.png

Lali-ho appears again

Toad has much more presence; some places can only be reached by shrinking or turning into a frog

Bombs appear

Fairies appear

Garuda appears

Doga, Xande, and Unei appear

Crystal Tower

Eureka

The souls of departed friends

People I helped in the past come back to help us

The Cloud of Darkness is the boss

There are no ethers

Shiva, Ramuh, Titan, Odin, and Bahamut appear

It feels like the protagonists in these games all have white hair

In the ending, the four Warriors of Darkness come out to help the Warriors of Light

Patch 5.0 is a huge tribute to FF3

Starting jobs:

Onion Knight, Warrior, Monk, White Mage, Black Mage, Red Mage

Unlock the Fire Crystal:

Ranger, Knight, Thief, Scholar

Unlock the Water Crystal:

Geomancer, Dragoon, Viking, Black Belt, Magic Knight, Illusionist, Bard

items.body:
出现了兔兔族

音乐很好听

dk的故事

rpg的故事感更强了一些

玩法有变化

有了中间可以存档的地方

双胞胎qwq

森林与水之都特罗亚，有种格利达尼亚的感觉

特罗亚城由女性守护

高贝扎大反派

泰拉因为失去女儿，被仇恨蒙蔽双眼，学会了陨石魔法，并用生命使用了它，但是却没有打败高贝扎

人偶副本里的人偶出现了

啦哩吼再次出现
items.excerpt_en: The bunny tribe appears, and the music is lovely. The dance in Mysidia is so cute, and Rydia is such an adorable little girl.
items.body_en:
The bunny tribe appears

The music is lovely

The Dark Knight's story

It feels more like an RPG story

Gameplay has changed

There are now places to save mid-dungeon

The dance in Mysidia is so cute

Rydia is such an adorable little girl

Twins qwq

Troia, the capital of forest and water, gives off a Gridania feeling

Troia has a priestess

Troia is guarded by women

Golbez is the big villain

The three little girls who serve the wind lady are fun

Tellah, blinded by hatred after losing his daughter, learns the Meteor spell and uses it with his life, but doesn't manage to defeat Golbez

Collect the Light Crystals and Dark Crystals and then go to the moon!

The dolls from the doll dungeon appear

Lali-ho appears again
